items.title: Pete Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999

ctx.x: No, well he was a wonderful lead player, but lead had already been established with Wildroot and all the things. So he felt right at home and he played just wonderful. He played great. Marvelous sound. And it turned out just great. And we had Marky Markowitz was on the band at one time, Neal Hefti was on the band, and we had the five trumpets, let’s see: Goz and I, and I can’t think of who was with us at that time.
Oh Sonny yeah. Neal Hefti. © Fillius Jazz Archive -7-
